name: Timemore Chestnut C2
details: Hand grinder; clicks counted from the start point (dial turned fully clockwise). Timemore advises not to grind at the finest 0–6 clicks.

rangeInfo.note: Timemore C2/C3 manual (multilingual, hosted by a retailer), table for C2/C2 Max: espresso 10–14 clicks, pour over 18–24, French press 25–27. “For your reference only.”
